The split-folding rear seat and three-row configuration provide flexible seating arrangements, while the rear seat media system keeps passengers engaged on longer journeys. Dual-zone automatic climate control ensures comfort for all occupants.

The Active Response 4WD system works in concert with the air ride adaptive suspension to manage terrain and driving conditions with precision. Electronic limited-slip differential technology enhances traction when needed, while hill descent control provides confidence during challenging descents. The integrated trailer brake controller and trailering assist guidelines demonstrate this vehicle's competence for those with towing needs.

Technology integration extends throughout the vehicle with the GMC Connected Navigation system, OnStar connectivity, and the premium infotainment display offering seamless smartphone integration. Advanced safety features include blind zone steering assist with trailering functionality, driver attention assist, and the comprehensive airbag system. The panoramic sunroof adds an open, airy quality to the driving experience.

This one-owner Yukon XL Denali in Glacier White Tricoat combines the luxury expectations of the Denali nameplate with the rugged capability the full-size SUV segment demands. Schedule your visit to explore its features and understand why this vehicle stands out as a complete package for those seeking premium SUV ownership.

The 2025 BMW X6 M60i represents a distinctive choice for those seeking a vehicle that combines performance, luxury, and advanced capability. This Gray specimen is powered by a 4.4L V8 32-valve twin-turbocharged engine paired with an 8-speed automatic sport transmission and all-wheel drive, delivering the dynamic response you expect from BMW's M line while maintaining everyday practicality.

- 22" M Dual-Spoke Black wheels with staggered sizing
- 4.4L Twin-Turbocharged V8 engine with 8-speed sport transmission
- All-wheel drive with Dynamic Handling Package and Active Roll Stabilization
- Adaptive M Suspension Professional for refined handling
- M Sport Brakes with Red Calipers and M Sport Professional Package
- Panoramic Sky Lounge LED Roof with Soft-Close Automatic Doors
- Front Massaging Seats with 4-Zone Automatic Climate Control and heated functionality
- Bowers & Wilkins Diamond Surround Sound System
- M Sport Package Pro with Extended Shadowline Trim and M Shadowline Lights
- Live Cockpit Pro with Gesture Control and Heads-Up Display
- Driving Assistance Professional Package with Highway Assistant and Active Cruise Control
- Parking Assistance Package with Automatic Park Assistant and Surround View
- Active Driving Assistant Pro with lane keeping and traffic jam assistance
- Navigation System with Connected Package Pro and Personal eSIM 5G
- Rear Manual Side Window Shades and wireless device charging

The interior establishes a commanding presence with its Leather Dashboard, Individual Piano Finish Black Trim, and thoughtfully appointed seating that combines support with comfort through front massaging and ventilated capabilities. Climate management extends throughout the cabin with 4-zone automatic temperature control complemented by heated seats and steering wheel, while the Panoramic Sky Lounge LED Roof floods the space with natural light and creates an open, airy environment.

Technology integration reflects BMW's commitment to connected driving, featuring the Live Cockpit Pro system, Apple CarPlay compatibility, and a comprehensive navigation suite. The Driving Assistance Professional Package addresses the demands of modern driving with highway assistant, active cruise control with stop and go functionality, active lane keeping assistance, and automatic lane change capability.

Safety and convenience merge seamlessly through the Parking Assistance Package, which includes automatic park assist, surrounding view with 3D perspective, backup assistant, and trailer assistant. The M Sport Professional Package elevates visual presence with distinctive M Sport Brakes featuring red calipers, extended shadowline trim, and M Shadowline lights that define the exterior character.

The Dynamic Handling Package works in concert with the Adaptive M Suspension Professional to deliver responsive handling that translates driver input into controlled, confident motion. This technological foundation, combined with all-wheel drive capability, creates a vehicle that adapts to varied driving conditions while maintaining the performance-oriented character BMW owners value.

This X6 M60i stands ready to provide the level of refinement, capability, and distinctive presence that sets it apart in its class. We welcome the opportunity to arrange a viewing and allow you to experience firsthand the integration of performance, luxury, and advanced engineering that defines this vehicle.

- Premium Paint
- Klipsch Reference Premiere Audio System with SiriusXM 360L
- Google Built-in Navigation System
- Climate Controlled Front Bucket Seats with Massage
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Power Moonroof
- Heads-Up Display
- Auto-dimming Rear-View Mirror
- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- 22" Cast Aluminum Alloy Wheels

Electronic Stability Control, traction control, ABS brakes with brake assist, and tire pressure monitoring work together with an adaptive suspension system to enhance stability and control across varying road conditions. The INFINITI InTouch emergency communication system provides additional security and connectivity.

Exterior design combines functionality with polished aesthetics through auto-dimming door mirrors, heated mirrors, rain sensing wipers with rear window wiper capability, and fully automatic adaptive headlights. The body-color bumpers and center front spoiler contribute to a cohesive appearance while the 22" cast aluminum alloy wheels provide a commanding presence on the road.

This 2025 QX80 AUTOGRAPH combines capability, luxury, and safety into a vehicle designed for discerning buyers who demand excellence. We invite you to schedule a visit to our showroom to experience this exceptional SUV firsthand and discuss how it meets your transportation needs.

Introducing the 2025 Ford Expedition King Ranch, a full-size SUV engineered to deliver capability, refinement, and presence on every road you travel.

- BlueCruise Equipped (1-Year Plan)
- Navigation System
- 22" Sinister Brown Wheels with Diamond Cut Face

The King Ranch trim represents Ford's commitment to luxury and sophistication within the full-size SUV segment. With its EcoBoost 3.5L V6 Twin Turbocharged engine paired to a 10-Speed Automatic transmission, this Expedition delivers the power you need with responsive performance. The 4WD system ensures confidence in varying road conditions, while the 3.73 axle ratio balances capability with efficiency.

Interior appointments reflect attention to detail and passenger comfort. The heated and ventilated front captain's chairs wrapped in premium Del Rio leather provide individual seating ease, while the heated rear seats extend comfort to your second row. The genuine wood dashboard and door panel inserts convey the quality expected of the King Ranch designation. Memory functions for both seats and steering wheel adjust automatically to your preferences.

Technology integration enhances every journey. The Navigation System guides you precisely, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keep your devices seamlessly integrated. SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio offers unlimited entertainment options. BlueCruise Equipped with a 1-Year Plan provides advanced driving assistance for supported roadways.

The power moonroof with Vista Roof technology floods the cabin with natural light, creating an open atmosphere for all passengers. The B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 22 carefully positioned speakers transforms your commute into an auditory experience.

Safety and handling work together seamlessly. Electronic Stability Control, four-wheel independent suspension with adaptive technology, and speed-sensing steering provide confidence in daily driving. The four-wheel disc brake system with ABS delivers reliable stopping power, while an extensive airbag system protects occupants.

The 22" Sinister Brown wheels with diamond cut faces command the road while the dark matter gray metallic exterior paint captures light beautifully. This Expedition presents itself with authority and refinement. Visit us today to experience the combination of luxury, capability, and thoughtful engineering that defines the 2025 Ford Expedition King Ranch.

Technology integration keeps you connected and informed on every drive. The 14-inch Lexus Interface touchscreen display handles navigation, entertainment, and vehicle controls with intuitive operation. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility ensure your smartphone integrates seamlessly, while the Drive Connect Cloud Navigation system with a 3-year trial subscription provides comprehensive route planning and real-time information.

Front Cross Traffic Alert with automatic braking, a comprehensive airbag system including knee and overhead airbags, and the Safety Connect emergency communication system (up to 10-year trial subscription included) provide multilayered protection. Four-wheel independent suspension and electronic stability control work together to maintain vehicle dynamics and traction.

The practical layout includes three rows of seating with a split-folding rear seat, exterior parking camera, rear window wiper, and a power liftgate that simplifies loading and unloading. The heated steering wheel and remote keyless entry add daily convenience, while 20-inch aluminum alloy wheels and body-color bumpers complete the premium appearance.

This 2024 Cadillac Escalade ESV Sport in Black represents refined full-size luxury with commanding presence and sophisticated engineering designed for those who demand the best in their vehicles.

- Power-Retractable Assist Steps with Perimeter Lighting
- 22" 12-Spoke Gloss Black Alloy Wheels with Monochrome Cadillac Emblems
- Air Ride Adaptive Suspension with Magnetic Ride Control
- 16.9" Diagonal OLED Infotainment Screen with Navigation
- AKG Studio 19-Speaker Audio System with SiriusXM 360L
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto
- Reconfigurable Full-Color Head-Up Display
- Leather Seating Surfaces with Heated & Ventilated Front Seats and Heated Rear Seats
- Soft-Closing Front and Rear Doors with Illuminating Sill Plates
- Power Panoramic Tilt-Sliding Sunroof
- Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking and Parking Assist
- Integrated Trailer Brake Controller with Hitch Guidance
- All-Weather Floor Liner Package with Full Row Coverage
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Speed Control
- Electronic Limited-Slip Differential with Four-Wheel Independent Suspension

The 6.2L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission delivers the performance expected from Cadillac's flagship SUV. All-wheel drive ensures capable handling across varying conditions, while the responsive steering and advanced suspension technology create a commanding driving experience that balances comfort with control.

The spacious interior accommodates up to eight passengers with front bucket seats, a split-folding rear seat, and a third-row bench configuration. The refined leather seating surfaces with precision perforated inserts convey luxury throughout the cabin. Heated and ventilated driver and front passenger seats provide personalized climate control, while the power-adjustable seating with memory presets allows each driver to establish their preferred position instantly.

Advanced technology enhances every journey through this vehicle. The expansive OLED infotainment screen integrates seamlessly with wireless smartphone connectivity, offering intuitive access to navigation, entertainment, and vehicle controls. The 19-speaker audio system delivers premium sound quality with SiriusXM satellite radio providing unlimited content options. The adaptive cruise control, automatic emergency braking, and rear cross traffic alert work together to support confident driving.

The Touring Package elevates the ownership experience with soft-close doors that close smoothly at the gentlest push, illuminating sill plates that greet occupants with ambient lighting, and the adaptive air suspension that continuously adjusts to road conditions for optimal comfort. The Onyx Package contributes visual distinction through the gloss black 22-inch wheels, matching nameplate, and exclusive Cadillac crest puddle lamps.

This Escalade ESV Sport stands ready to serve discerning buyers seeking a luxury full-size SUV that combines capability, refinement, and technological sophistication. We invite you to experience this vehicle firsthand at our showroom.

This 2024 GMC Yukon XL Denali Ultimate in Onyx Black represents the pinnacle of full-size SUV capability and luxury, offering substantial three-row seating and commanding presence for those who demand the best.

- Bose Performance Series Sound System with 18 speakers and SiriusXM 360L
- Super Cruise advanced driver assistance technology
- Air Ride Adaptive Suspension with Magnetic Ride Control
- Full grain leather heated and ventilated front seats with 16-way power adjusters
- Heated rear seats and 3rd row 60/40 power-folding split-bench seating
- Dual-pane panoramic power sunroof
- 15-inch diagonal multi-color heads-up display with navigation system
- HD surround vision with enhanced automatic emergency braking and parking assist
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Adaptive cruise control with speed control
- Trailer side blind zone alert and integrated trailer brake controller
- 22-inch ultra-bright machined aluminum wheels
- Heated power-adjustable door mirrors with auto-dimming capability
- Enhanced automatic emergency braking and rear pedestrian alert

The EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine delivers the performance you expect, paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability for confident handling in any condition. Maximum towing package integration provides smart trailer hookup and brake control for seamless trailering. With city fuel economy of 14 mpg and highway ratings of 18 mpg, this machine balances power with reasonable efficiency for its class.

Inside, the Denali Ultimate trim surrounds you with premium appointments. Full grain leather seating extends throughout, with heated and ventilated front positions offering customizable comfort. Memory seat functions preserve your preferred driving position, while the power telescoping steering column adjusts to accommodate your ideal setup. Heated steering wheel and automatic temperature control with front dual-zone air conditioning ensure year-round comfort for all occupants.

Technology integration keeps you connected and informed. The wireless charging pad eliminates cable clutter, while the OnStar-enabled emergency communication system and GMC connected services provide peace of mind. The HD surround vision system displays a comprehensive 360-degree view, making parking and maneuvering this large SUV straightforward. Rear cross traffic alert, reverse automatic braking, and rear pedestrian alert add multiple layers of safety awareness.

Advanced safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and occupant-sensing technology. Electronic stability control, traction control, and hill descent control work together with four-wheel independent suspension to maintain stability. The glass breakage sensor and theft-deterrent alarm system provide comprehensive security for your investment.

Includes Life Time Oil Changes, State Inspections, Towing and much more!!!

This 2024 Mercedes-Benz GLE 53 AMG® 4MATIC® in Gray combines sophisticated design with capable performance for those seeking a premium luxury SUV.

- 3.0L I6 Turbo engine with 9-Speed Automatic transmission and 4MATIC® all-wheel drive
- MBUX 12.3" Media Display with Touchscreen and Navigation system
- Apple CarPlay®/Android Auto® integration
- Premium audio system with 13 speakers and SiriusXM capability
- Panorama Power Moonroof
- Heated and Ventilated Nappa Leather Front Seats with Memory
- MB-Tex Dashboard and Door Panels with Brushed Aluminum Trim
- 21" AMG® Twin 5-Spoke Wheels with High Performance Tires
- Adaptive and Auto-Leveling Suspension with Four Wheel Independent Suspension

The AMG® styling elevates this GLE with aggressive yet refined aesthetics. The gray exterior finish showcases the athletic proportions and bold front grille characteristic of the model. Power door mirrors with heating and turn signal indicators enhance functionality, while the body-color bumpers and spoiler contribute to its commanding curb presence.

Inside, the cabin reflects Mercedes-Benz's commitment to luxury and technology. The MBUX system provides intuitive control over navigation, entertainment, and vehicle settings through the touchscreen interface. Heated and ventilated front seats wrapped in genuine Nappa leather offer support for long drives, while the driver's seat includes memory functions for personalized positioning. The panorama moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, creating an open, airy atmosphere.

Performance and safety work seamlessly together in this GLE 53 AMG®. The all-wheel-drive system delivers confidence in varied driving conditions, while the adaptive suspension adjusts to road surfaces and driving dynamics. Electronic stability control, traction control, and the comprehensive airbag system provide multiple layers of protection. The four-wheel independent suspension ensures responsive handling balanced with ride comfort.

Technology enhances every journey through intuitive features like HomeLink Garage door transmitter, the eCall Emergency System for added peace of mind, and trip computer functions that keep you informed. The sports steering wheel with mounted audio controls puts essential functions within reach, while the telescoping and tilt adjustment ensures an optimal driving position for any operator.

At 23,724 miles, this GLE 53 AMG® represents a well-maintained vehicle ready for its next owner. With an EPA rating of 18 city and 22 highway MPG, this turbocharged engine balances performance with reasonable consumption. Schedule your visit to the showroom to experience the commanding presence and refined capabilities of this Mercedes-Benz SUV firsthand.

Experience the commanding presence of the 2024 Lexus GX 550 Luxury+, a three-row luxury SUV engineered for those who demand capability without compromise.

- 3.4L V6 engine with 10-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD
- Head-Up Display for enhanced driver awareness
- Lexus Interface with 14" touchscreen and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto compatibility
- Drive Connect Cloud Navigation with 3-year trial subscription
- Digital Key and SmartAccess card key technology
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with semi-aniline leather trim
- Power-folding third row seats for flexible cargo management
- Second row captain's chairs for premium passenger comfort
- All-Weather Floor Liners and All-Weather Cargo Mat
- Traffic Jam Assist with Lane Change Assist and Front Cross Traffic Alert-Braking
- Cold Area Package including windshield wiper de-icer and headlamp washer
- Power liftgate and tonneau cover for convenient access and security
- 22" aluminum alloy wheels with cross bars
- Safety Connect emergency communication system with up to 10-year trial subscription

This GX model combines luxury appointments with practical versatility. The three-row seating arrangement accommodates up to eight passengers, while the captain's chairs in the second row provide individual comfort for premium travel. The power-folding third row expands your cargo capabilities when needed, and dual-zone climate control ensures every passenger travels in comfort.

The Luxury+ trim delivers a curated selection of technologies designed to simplify your drives. The head-up display projects essential driving information directly into your line of sight, reducing distractions. Digital Key technology allows you to unlock and start your vehicle using your smartphone, while the SmartAccess card key offers a traditional alternative. The Drive Connect Cloud Navigation system provides three years of complimentary subscription service.

Safety and driver assistance features are comprehensive. Traffic Jam Assist technology includes front cross traffic alert with automatic braking, lane change assist, and a driver monitor camera to help you navigate congested roadways with greater confidence. The vehicle is equipped with multiple airbags, electronic stability control, and anti-lock brakes as standard.

With 15 city and 21 highway MPG, the GX balances the performance of its 3.4L V6 with reasonable fuel efficiency for a full-size luxury SUV. The 4WD system ensures capable traction in various weather conditions, while the all-weather floor liners and cargo mat protect your interior investment.

This 2024 Lexus GX 550 Luxury+ is ready to become your trusted companion for family adventures and daily driving alike. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this premium SUV firsthand and explore what ownership means for your lifestyle.

The 2023 Chevrolet Tahoe Premier in elegant black represents a commanding presence on the road, designed to deliver capability and refinement for families and professionals who demand both performance and comfort. This full-size SUV combines sophisticated styling with practical functionality, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a vehicle that handles daily driving and adventure with equal confidence.

- Dual-pane power panoramic sunroof with express-open and close and power sunshade
- 22" polished aluminum wheels
- Bose 10-speaker Centerpoint surround audio system
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Power liftgate with hands-free rear programmable operation
- Heated and ventilated driver and front passenger seats
- Heated 2nd row outboard seats
- Front and rear automatic climate control with dual-zone capability
- Premium leather seat trim throughout
- Magnetic Ride Control adaptive suspension
- Lane change alert with side blind zone alert
- Rear cross traffic alert
- Hill descent control
- Navigation system
- Wireless charging
- SiriusXM 360L satellite radio

The Premier trim emphasizes comfort and connectivity. The advanced climate control system maintains separate temperatures for driver and passenger, while heated and ventilated front seats provide year-round comfort. Heated rear seats ensure all passengers enjoy the journey. The power panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light and creates an open, spacious atmosphere. Premium perforated leather seating surfaces add luxury and durability throughout the three-row configuration.

The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability provides the power you need for varied driving conditions. The Magnetic Ride Control suspension adapts to road surfaces intelligently, delivering a smooth ride while maintaining stability. Speed-sensing steering adjusts effort according to vehicle speed, enhancing both highway efficiency and parking maneuverability.

Technology integration elevates every drive. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system streams music through a premium Bose audio setup, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto seamlessly integrate your smartphone. Navigation guidance keeps you on course, and the wireless charging pad eliminates fumbling with cables. OnStar connectivity provides emergency services and remote vehicle access capability.

Safety features work continuously to protect your passengers. Multiple airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control provide active protection. Advanced awareness systems including lane change alert with side blind zone alert and rear cross traffic alert help you navigate complex driving situations. Hill descent control proves invaluable when negotiating steep mountain roads or challenging terrain.

The Tahoe Premier delivers practicality without compromise. The hands-free power liftgate operates with a simple kick gesture, making loading groceries or cargo effortless. Split-folding rear seats maximize versatility, transforming the spacious interior for passengers or cargo as your needs change. Three rows of seating accommodate up to eight occupants comfortably. Memory settings recall your preferred seat position, mirror angles, and steering wheel location, personalizing the cabin for each regular driver.

This black 2023 Chevrolet Tahoe Premier stands ready to serve your family or business with capable performance, advanced technology, and genuine luxury. We invite you to experience this remarkable SUV firsthand—visit our showroom to sit behind the wheel and discover why the Tahoe Premier remains a leading choice for those who refuse to compromise between capability, comfort, and style.

- 22" M Double-Spoke Wheels with Performance Tires

The panoramic sunroof with glass controls floods the interior with natural light. With approximately 26,667 miles on the odometer, this BMW has been carefully maintained and remains in excellent condition. It arrives as a non-smoker vehicle with both key fobs included. The combination of prestige, performance, and modern technology makes this X5 M50i an exceptional choice for those seeking a luxury SUV that performs as impressively as it looks.

This 2023 Toyota Sequoia Platinum in Beige combines luxury, capability, and efficiency in a three-row SUV designed for families who demand comfort without compromise. With a V6 Hybrid engine paired to a 10-Speed Automatic transmission and available 4WD, this Sequoia delivers the reliability Toyota is known for while achieving an impressive 19 city and 22 highway MPG.

- Head Up Display (HUD) with 10-inch color display, speedometer, navigation, and hybrid system indicator
- Black heated power auto-dim outside tow mirrors with turn signal and blind spot warning indicators
- Load-leveling rear height control air suspension (AVS)
- Automatic power extending running boards
- JBL Premium Audio System with 14 speakers and SiriusXM
- Navigation system with Drive Connect (1 year trial) and Google POI integration
- Heated and ventilated front seats with leather trim
- Heated steering wheel with steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Power moonroof
- 20" machined-finish black alloy wheels
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Three-row seating with split-folding rear and reclining third row
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror with compass and HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel disc ABS brakes
- Dual front and side impact airbags with knee and overhead airbags

As a Toyota Gold Certified vehicle, this Sequoia has passed a comprehensive Multipoint Inspection and comes backed by coverage designed to provide peace of mind. The certification includes a 12-Month/12,000-Mile Limited Comprehensive Warranty, an 84-Month/100,000-Mile Powertrain Limited Warranty, and 7-Year/100,000-Mile Roadside Assistance. Additional benefits include a $0 warranty deductible, transferable warranty coverage, vehicle history report, and access to over 1,400 Toyota dealers across the continental U.S. and Canada for warranty service. Standard new-car financing rates are available, and we handle all DMV paperwork to ensure a trouble-free transaction.

The interior reflects the Platinum trim's attention to detail, with leather seating surfaces throughout, heated front seats with ventilation, heated rear seats, and a heated steering wheel for year-round comfort. The power driver and passenger seats offer multiple adjustment options, while the auto tilt-away steering wheel and telescoping steering column accommodate various driver preferences. Rear passengers benefit from reclining third-row seating and a center armrest with convenient storage.

Safety technology is integrated throughout, featuring Electronic Stability Control, speed-sensing steering, traction control, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. The Safety Connect emergency communication system comes with a 10-year trial, providing added security for you and your family. Advanced lighting includes auto high-beam headlights, delay-off functionality, front fog lights, and headlight cleaning to maintain visibility in all conditions.

Convenience features include remote keyless entry, automatic power extending running boards for easier access, a power liftgate for hands-free cargo management, and rain-sensing wipers with rear window wiper capability. The climate control system offers front dual-zone air conditioning and rear air conditioning with rear window defroster, ensuring every passenger travels in comfort regardless of weather.

This 2023 Toyota Sequoia Platinum represents an opportunity to own a certified luxury SUV with proven hybrid efficiency, comprehensive warranty protection, and the Toyota commitment to quality and reliability. We welcome your visit to experience this vehicle firsthand and discuss how it meets your family's needs.

This 2023 Chevrolet Tahoe Z71 in Radiant Red combines capability and refinement for those who demand both performance and comfort. The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission delivers the power you need for any situation, whether towing your boat or hauling cargo across town. Four-wheel drive with the 2-Speed Active Electronic AutoTrac Transfer Case ensures you can confidently handle any terrain the road throws your way.

The cabin showcases premium appointments throughout. Leather-appointed seats with 10-way power adjustability for the driver and passenger provide support for long journeys. Heated front and second row outboard seats keep everyone comfortable during colder months, while the heated steering wheel adds a thoughtful touch. The power panoramic sunroof floods the interior with natural light, creating an open, airy atmosphere that elevates every drive.

Entertainment and convenience features work seamlessly together. The dual rear seat-mounted 12.6" HD touchscreen media system keeps passengers engaged, while the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Navigation keeps you connected and on course. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration ensures your smartphone becomes an extension of your vehicle's technology. SiriusXM 360L satellite radio, combined with the Bose 9-speaker audio system, delivers exceptional sound quality for your favorite programs and music.

Safety and technology take center stage with comprehensive driver assistance features. The HD Surround Vision system provides enhanced visibility, while Rear Pedestrian Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, and Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert work together to keep you aware of your surroundings. Electronic stability control, hill descent control, and a sophisticated suspension system give you confidence in any driving condition.

The Max Trailering Package with integrated trailer brake controller and Smart Trailer Integration makes towing straightforward and secure. Hitch Guidance with Hitch View simplifies hookups, while red horizontal-mounted recovery hooks add functional style that reflects this vehicle's off-road heritage.

Gates Chevrolet backs your purchase with Customer for Life Warranty. When you invest in this Tahoe Z71, you're investing in a vehicle engineered for years of reliable service. We encourage you to schedule a test drive and experience firsthand how this full-size SUV can enhance your lifestyle while delivering the capability and luxury you deserve.

The V6 Hybrid engine combined with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers a balanced approach to power and efficiency, achieving 19 city and 22 highway mpg. The TRD Pro Package distinguishes this Sequoia with purposeful enhancements including TRD Pro leather-trimmed steering wheel, TRD Pro SofTex seat trim, and TRD Pro LED light bar. Interior comfort is evident throughout the cabin. Heated and cooled front seats keep occupants comfortable in any season, while the three-row configuration with split-folding rear seat and reclining third-row seats accommodates passengers and cargo flexibly. The automatic climate control maintains separate temperature zones, and the rear air conditioning ensures passenger comfort in all conditions.

Technology integration reflects modern expectations. The JBL premium audio system delivers quality sound through 14 speakers, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keeps you seamlessly linked to your devices. The multi-terrain back monitor, combined with the rear camera and dash cam, provides visibility and security. Wireless smartphone charging and smart USB phone cables offer convenience for daily use.

Safety and security features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbag, and overhead airbag protection. Electronic stability control and traction control work actively to maintain stability, while brake assist supports confident stopping. This 2023 Land Rover Range Rover Sport SE Dynamic delivers capable performance and refined comfort for drivers who demand both sophistication and substance.

- 19-Speaker Meridian Premium Audio System
- Navigation System with InControl Navigation Pro
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Integration
- Power Moonroof
- 20-Way Electric Heated Front Seats with Memory
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Perforated Windsor Leather Seat Trim
- Auto-Dimming Rear-View Mirror
- Adaptive Suspension

The 3.0L I6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers confident handling across various driving conditions. You'll appreciate the responsive steering and suspension tuning that balances comfort during daily driving with controlled stability when cornering. The vehicle achieves an estimated 18 city and 26 highway MPG, offering reasonable efficiency for a vehicle of this capability and size.

Inside, the cabin reflects the attention to detail that defines this model. The 20-way heated front seats with memory ensure personalized comfort, while the heated steering wheel adds warmth on cold mornings. The perforated Windsor leather trim conveys quality and durability, supported by thoughtful amenities including HomeLink garage door control and an overhead console with practical storage solutions.

Technology integration focuses on what matters most during your commute and weekend adventures. The InControl Navigation Pro system guides you reliably, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep your smartphone's essential functions within easy reach. The 19-speaker Meridian audio system transforms your cabin into a concert hall, and the rain-sensing wipers with rear window wiper function handle weather automatically.

Safety and security receive equal emphasis. The dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive protection, while the occupant-sensing technology calibrates deployment appropriately. Electronic stability control and traction control work seamlessly with the four-wheel independent suspension to maintain grip and composure.

The gray exterior combines with those 21-inch satin dark grey alloy wheels to create a cohesive, contemporary appearance. Auto-dimming door mirrors and headlight cleaning ensure visibility regardless of conditions, while the power liftgate makes loading and unloading effortless.

This Range Rover Sport SE Dynamic represents a thoughtfully equipped vehicle ready to meet the demands of discerning drivers. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the capabilities firsthand.

- Adaptive cruise control
- Bose 14-speaker surround sound system with CenterPoint

Advanced technology defines this vehicle's capabilities. The adaptive suspension adjusts automatically to road conditions, while the magnetic ride control system enhances both comfort and handling. The dual exhaust system contributes to the vehicle's commanding voice while electronic stability control and traction control work continuously to maintain stability.

Front and rear park assist aids maneuvering in tight spaces, while four-wheel disc ABS brakes ensure responsive stopping power. The system includes dual front impact and side airbags plus overhead airbags for occupant protection.

This 2023 GMC Yukon Denali combines capability, technology, and luxury into a vehicle built for those who appreciate quality and performance. Contact our dealership today to arrange a test drive and experience the refinement this Denali provides.

This 2023 Mercedes-Benz GLS 580 4MATIC® represents a significant investment in luxury, capability, and refined engineering designed for discerning drivers who demand both performance and elegant comfort.

- MB Navigation system
- MBUX Multimedia System with Apple CarPlay®/Android Auto®
- Burmester® Surround Sound System with 13 speakers
- Active Multicontour Front Seats with massage feature
- Power moonroof with panorama design
- 7-seat configuration with heated and ventilated front seats
- Leather upholstery throughout
- 4.0L V8 engine with 9-speed automatic transmission and 4MATIC® all-wheel drive
- 21" AMG® twin 5-spoke alloy wheels
- Electronic Stability Control with adaptive suspension
- Four-wheel independent suspension with auto-leveling capability
- Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off function
- eCall Emergency Communication System
- Panoramic power moonroof with auto tilt-away steering wheel

The powertrain combines a robust 4.0L V8 engine with intelligent 4MATIC® all-wheel drive, delivering the capability you expect from a Mercedes-Benz performance vehicle. The nine-speed automatic transmission ensures smooth power delivery across all driving conditions, whether navigating city streets at 16 miles per gallon or cruising highways at 21 miles per gallon. This proven engineering foundation establishes confidence in every journey.

Inside, the cabin showcases genuine wood accents throughout the dashboard, console, and door panels, establishing an atmosphere of understated luxury. The active multicontour front seats provide adjustable support and integrated massage functionality, transforming longer drives into opportunities for comfort rather than fatigue. Heated and ventilated front seats, along with power adjustment capabilities for both driver and passenger, allow each occupant to customize their experience precisely.

The seven-seat layout accommodates your family or passengers with thoughtful design, including a split-folding rear seat that adapts to your cargo needs. Climate control reaches all three rows through front dual-zone and rear dual-zone automatic temperature systems, ensuring everyone travels in comfort. The split-bench third row seats expand your flexibility for passengers or additional storage space.

Advanced safety features integrate seamlessly throughout the vehicle. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags work in concert with electronic stability control and an active brake assist system including cross-traffic function. The potent V8 engine delivers responsive performance while the eight-speed automatic transmission ensures smooth power delivery for both highway and city driving. At 16 city MPG and 21 highway MPG, you'll appreciate the efficiency this powerplant provides. The white exterior finish presents a clean, modern appearance that commands attention.

Inside, the cabin showcases premium materials and thoughtful design. Genuine wood trim accents the dashboard, console, and door panels. Extended Merino leather upholstery wraps the front bucket seats, which feature power adjustment, heating, cooling, and massage functions. The three-zone climate control keeps all passengers comfortable, while the panoramic sky lounge roof floods the cabin with natural light through its dynamic glass controls.

The Driving Assistance Professional Package integrates advanced technology into your daily driving. Adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go capability, active lane-keeping assistance with side collision avoidance, steering and traffic jam assistant, and automatic lane change functionality work together to enhance both safety and convenience. The active driving assistant pro continually monitors road conditions to provide steering and braking interventions when needed.

Technology connectivity is seamless with personal eSIM 5G, wireless charging, and full smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The head-up display projects critical information directly into your line of sight, while the comprehensive BMW Maps navigation system ensures you always know your route. BMW Assist eCall and TeleServices provide additional peace of mind.

Safety features include dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control provide confident stopping power and vehicle dynamics. The adaptive and auto-leveling suspension system maintains composure across varying road surfaces while the four-wheel independent suspension maximizes ride quality and handling.

We're pleased to offer nationwide shipping anywhere in the United States—your new BMW X7 M60i can arrive at your preferred location. Schedule your test drive today and discover how this luxury SUV combines elegance with performance.

description: This 2023 GMC Yukon XL Denali combines commanding presence with refined capability, offering a full-size SUV designed for those who demand both strength and sophistication.- Denali Reserve Package with Advanced Technology Package content- Dual rear seat-mounted 12.6 color-touch LCD HD screens with Wi-Fi projection- Panoramic power sunroof- 22 bright machined aluminum wheels- Power-retractable assist steps with perimeter lighting- Super Cruise semi-autonomous driving capability- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 10-Speed Automatic transmission- Adaptive Cruise Control with Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking- Bose 14-Speaker Surround Sound system with SiriusXM 360L- HD Surround Vision camera system- Heated and ventilated driver and front passenger seats- Premium floor liner package with all-weather cargo mat- Magnetic Ride Control Suspension with air ride adaptive technology- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto- Wireless charging and heated steering wheelThe Yukon XL Denali presents an EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission with overdrive, delivering the capability expected from a full-size luxury SUV. The 4WD system includes Premium Capability Package with Active Response 4WD, providing enhanced traction and control across varied driving conditions. Combined with Electronic Limited Slip Differential and traction control, this vehicle handles with precision.Inside, the Denali Reserve trim establishes a sanctuary of comfort and technology. Perforated leather seating surfaces wrap heated and ventilated front seats, while the available heated rear seats extend comfort to passengers. The power-adjustable steering column and power-expandable assist steps make entry effortless for all occupants. Premium floor liners and all-weather cargo mats protect the interior throughout the ownership experience.Technology integration is comprehensive and purposeful. The 15-inch diagonal head-up display projects essential driving information directly into your line of sight. The rear seat media system features dual 12.6-inch LCD screens with Wi-Fi projection and Bluetooth® headphones, transforming long journeys for passengers. The navigation system, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto connectivity ensure seamless integration with your digital life.Safety systems work proactively to protect your family. Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, and Automatic Emergency Braking with Enhanced capabilities provide multiple layers of protection. The HD Surround Vision system, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, and Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert deliver comprehensive awareness. Forward and Rear Pedestrian Braking systems add an extra measure of security in urban environments.The Magnetic Ride Control suspension adapts in real time to road conditions, while the air ride adaptive suspension system automatically levels the vehicle. This combination delivers a smooth, controlled ride whether you're navigating city streets or highway stretches. The Max Trailering Package ensures capability for serious towing needs.This 2023 GMC Yukon XL Denali represents a thoughtfully equipped full-size luxury SUV ready for your most ambitious drives. We invite you to experience this vehicle firsthand and discover how it can serve your family's needs.

This 2023 Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 392 20th Anniversary represents a distinctive opportunity to own a vehicle built to celebrate Jeep's heritage while delivering genuine off-road capability and on-road performance.

- SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 Engine with 8-Speed Automatic Transmission
- Sky 1-Touch Power Top with Removable Rear Quarter Windows
- Rubicon 20th Anniversary Grille, Hood Decals, and Shifter Medallion
- MOPAR HD Rock Slider with Step Assist
- Xtreme Recon 35" Tire Package with BF Goodrich Brand Tires
- Rubicon 20th Anniversary Suspension System
- Nappa Leather Seats with Red Interior Accents
- Uconnect 4C Navigation with 8.4" Display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- Integrated Off-Road Camera
- Heated Front Seats and Steering Wheel
- MOPAR 3 Bar Bumper Hoop
- Class II Receiver Hitch with 7 and 4 Pin Wiring Harness
- Auto High-Beam Headlights with Front Fog Lights
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera

Finished in White with approximately 23,535 miles, this Wrangler combines heritage-inspired styling with modern capability. The specialized 20th Anniversary package distinguishes this model through exclusive badging, a custom grille design, and anniversary-specific interior appointments. The removable Sky Power Top allows you to adapt the driving experience from fully enclosed to open-air configuration, while the Removable Rear Quarter Windows provide additional flexibility for outdoor enthusiasts.

The SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 engine paired with an 8-Speed Automatic transmission delivers the power expected from this platform. The Rubicon 20th Anniversary Suspension with 35-inch BF Goodrich tires addresses both highway driving and serious off-road conditions. The integrated off-road camera and MOPAR rock sliders with step assist provide practical advantages when navigating challenging terrain.

Interior features emphasize both comfort and functionality. Nappa leather seats with red accent stitching, a heated steering wheel, and dual-zone automatic climate control create a refined cabin environment. The Uconnect 4C navigation system with an 8.4-inch touchscreen includes Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected during every drive. Premium audio comes through a 9-speaker system with SiriusXM satellite radio.

This vehicle includes the complete Quick Order Package 27T Rubicon 20th Anniversary specification, which incorporates factory-installed MOPAR components including an air compressor, tire relocation kit, jack spacer, and a specialized tool kit. The Trailer Tow Package with Class II Receiver Hitch and 7 and 4 Pin Wiring Harness supports practical hauling needs. Additional features such as the heated door mirrors, compass, and outside temperature display add everyday utility.

We invite you to schedule a visit to see this 2023 Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 392 20th Anniversary in person. Our team can walk you through the distinctive 20th Anniversary features, explain the capabilities of the off-road systems, and address any questions about ownership and maintenance.

- Dual-Pane Power Panoramic Sunroof with express-open and close and power sunshade
- 22" Carbon Flash Metallic Aluminum Wheels with selective machining
- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Max Trailering Package with Advanced Trailering and extra capacity cooling
- Rear Seat Media System with dual 12.6" screens and Wi-Fi projection

The rear seat media system with dual screens and Bluetooth headphones transforms long trips into enjoyable experiences for passengers.

With 47,622 miles and meticulous care evident throughout, this High Country Suburban is ready to provide years of dependable service. The combination of capability, refinement, and advanced technology makes this an intelligent choice for buyers who demand performance without compromise.

description: This 2023 Cadillac Escalade Premium Luxury delivers commanding presence and refined capability for those who demand excellence in a full-size luxury SUV.- Crystal White Tricoat exterior finish- 6.2L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive- 22-inch 14-spoke polished alloy wheels- Power panoramic tilt-sliding sunroof- Super Cruise hands-free driver assistance system- 16.9-inch diagonal OLED infotainment screen with navigation- AKG Studio 19-speaker audio system with SiriusXM 360L- Leather seating surfaces with heated and ventilated front seats- Heated rear seats and split-folding third-row seating- Heads-up display with reconfigurable full-color graphics- All-weather integrated cargo liner and floor liner package- Enhanced automatic emergency braking and parking assist- Rear camera mirror with washer function- 3 years of OnStar & Connected Services Plan- Highway Safety Kit with additional driver assistance featuresEvery detail reflects Cadillac's commitment to luxury and sophistication. The 6.2L V8 engine delivers substantial power while the all-wheel-drive system provides confidence and control in varied driving conditions. The refined interior offers an abundance of comfort features, from the heated and ventilated front seats to the comprehensive climate control system that extends to all three rows. Temperature adjustment occurs with precision through automatic dual-zone air conditioning and rear climate control.The advanced technology suite enhances both safety and convenience. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps you connected seamlessly. The heads-up display projects critical driving information directly into your line of sight, while adaptive cruise control and enhanced automatic emergency braking work together to support safer driving. Super Cruise capability delivers hands-free assistance on compatible roads, allowing for a more relaxed driving experience on extended journeys.Inside, the thoughtfully designed cabin accommodates up to eight passengers with versatility. Memory seats save your preferred driving position, and the power liftgate simplifies cargo management. The all-weather floor liner package protects the interior investment while maintaining the premium aesthetic. Storage solutions throughout the cabin including the front center armrest and multiple door bins keep essentials within reach.The exterior combines striking design with practical functionality. The 22-inch polished alloy wheels make a bold statement, while puddle lamps bearing the Cadillac crest welcome you each time you approach. Heated door mirrors, running board assist steps, and an integrated rear camera mirror washer demonstrate attention to the details that matter in daily use. The power panoramic sunroof bathes the interior in natural light and creates an open, airy atmosphere.With 28,500 miles on the odometer, this Escalade remains well within its prime, backed by the included three-year OnStar & Connected Services Plan that provides safety features, security assistance, and remote vehicle access. The combination of forward-thinking technology, genuine luxury materials, and commanding performance makes this Premium Luxury model an exceptional choice for discerning buyers who appreciate quality without compromise.

This 2023 Toyota Sequoia Capstone in Gray delivers three-row capability with refined luxury and dependable hybrid efficiency for families and adventurers alike.

- V6 Hybrid with 10-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- 19 city / 22 highway MPG
- JBL Premium Audio System with 14 speakers
- Power moonroof
- Navigation system with Drive Connect (1 year trial) and Google POI
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Heads-Up Display (HUD)
- Heated and ventilated front seats with power adjustment
- Heated rear seats and steering wheel
- 22" Machined-Finish Alloy wheels
- Auto High-beam headlights with headlight cleaning
- Automatic power-extending running boards
- Safety Connect (10-year trial) emergency communication
- Semi-Aniline leather seat trim
- Three rows with split-folding rear seat and reclining third row

The Sequoia Capstone balances performance with comfort in a spacious three-row layout designed for family adventures. The V6 Hybrid powertrain with 4WD offers the capability you need while the 10-speed automatic provides smooth, responsive handling. Gray exterior paint provides a sophisticated appearance that masks dirt and maintains a polished look between washes.

Inside, the cabin showcases premium materials and thoughtful design. Semi-Aniline leather seats combine durability with luxury, while heated and ventilated front seats ensure comfort in any season. Heated rear seats and a heated steering wheel extend that comfort to all passengers. The power moonroof opens the cabin to natural light and fresh air.

Technology seamlessly integrates into daily driving. The Heads-Up Display projects essential information directly into your line of sight, while the navigation system with Drive Connect provides real-time traffic and Google Points of Interest. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep your smartphone content accessible safely. The JBL Premium Audio System with 14 speakers transforms every commute into an entertainment experience.

Safety receives comprehensive attention with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and anti-whiplash front head restraints work together to protect occupants. Safety Connect provides emergency communication with a ten-year trial included.

The practical features make ownership straightforward. Automatic power-extending running boards make entry and exit easier for all passengers. The power liftgate eliminates fumbling with hands full of cargo. Rain-sensing wipers adjust to changing weather conditions automatically. Remote keyless entry and HomeLink garage door transmitter add convenience to your daily routine.

This 2023 Toyota Sequoia Capstone combines executive comfort, family functionality, and hybrid efficiency into a vehicle ready for whatever you need to accomplish.

This 2023 GMC Yukon Denali in Silver delivers the capability and refinement you expect from a premium full-size SUV, ready to serve your family with confidence and style.

- Power panoramic dual-pane sunroof with express-open and power sunshade

The spacious three-row layout accommodates your entire family comfortably, with power-folding capability for the third row to maximize cargo flexibility. Climate zones for front and rear passengers ensure everyone travels in comfort.

Safety technology is comprehensive, featuring automatic emergency braking with front pedestrian detection, rear cross traffic alert, and rear pedestrian alert. The lane keep assist and lane departure warning help you maintain your intended path, while the following distance indicator provides real-time spacing awareness. OnStar Safety and Security is included for three years, giving you added peace of mind.

This vehicle has passed a complete safety inspection and comes with service records available for your review. The recent trade-in status combined with well-maintained brakes and tires speaks to the care this Yukon has received. Remote start functionality adds convenience for cold mornings or warming up in summer heat.

We invite you to experience this Yukon Denali in person and discover how its blend of capability, technology, and luxury can enhance your daily driving and adventures ahead.

This 2023 Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 392 represents a rare opportunity to own one of the most capable and distinctive off-road vehicles available today. As a one-owner vehicle with exceptional care documented throughout its ownership, this Wrangler delivers both legendary performance and uncompromising quality.

- SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- 20th Anniversary Edition Rubicon with commemorative badging and exclusive styling
- AEV lift suspension for enhanced ground clearance and off-road capability
- Fuel wheels
- 40" Mickey Thompson MTZ tires
- Premium Black Sunrider soft top with convertible hardtop option
- Nappa leather heated seats with red accent stitching
- MOPAR HD rock sliders with step assist for protection and accessibility
- Uconnect 4C navigation system with 8.4-inch touchscreen display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- SiriusXM satellite radio with Guardian emergency communication
- Integrated off-road camera for trail visibility
- MOPAR air compressor and complete 20th Anniversary tool kit
- Heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic climate control
- Class II receiver hitch with 7 and 4-pin wiring harness

The SRT HEMI V8 powerplant sets this Wrangler apart from standard models, delivering commanding performance whether navigating city streets or tackling demanding terrain. The 20th Anniversary Edition designation adds collector value and exclusivity, marking this as a special production year that honors Rubicon's legacy. With custom Fuel wheels and the AEV lift system already installed, this vehicle represents a significant investment in capability and aesthetics that cannot be easily replicated.

Inside, the cabin reflects both adventure and refinement. Nappa leather buckets trimmed in red accents provide comfort for extended journeys, while the heated steering wheel and dual-zone climate control ensure comfort in any season. The Uconnect 4C navigation system with its 8.4-inch display handles all your connectivity needs, and the nine-speaker audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio transforms every drive into an engaging experience.

Functionality meets protection with thoughtfully engineered features throughout. The MOPAR HD rock sliders with step assist provide undercarriage protection while improving entry and exit on uneven terrain. The integrated off-road camera gives you enhanced visibility when navigating technical trails, while the MOPAR air compressor lets you adjust tire pressure on demand. Electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system work together to keep you and your passengers secure.

The convertible design defines the Wrangler experience. The Premium Black Sunrider soft top pairs with the available hardtop configuration, giving you flexibility to adapt to weather and mood. Red seat belts and interior accents coordinate beautifully with the black exterior and red-trimmed details throughout, creating a cohesive design that catches attention everywhere you go.

This 2023 GMC Yukon AT4 in Black delivers the capability and comfort you need for both daily driving and adventure. With its commanding presence and thoughtfully designed interior, this three-row SUV is ready to handle whatever you require.

- Power Panoramic Dual-Pane Sunroof with power sunshade
- Second Row Power Release Bucket Seats
- Max Trailering Package with ProGrade Trailering System
- Magnetic Ride Control Suspension with adaptive suspension
- Bose 9-Speaker Stereo Audio System with SiriusXM 360L
- Heated and Ventilated Driver and Front Passenger Seats
- Navigation System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Perforated Leather Seating Surfaces
- Three-Row 60/40 Power-Folding Split-Bench Third Row Seat
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning
- Automatic Emergency Braking with Front Pedestrian Braking
- Rear Cross Traffic Alert and Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert
- Hands-Free Power Programmable Rear Liftgate
- 20-Inch Machined Aluminum Wheels

The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with the 10-speed automatic transmission provides responsive power for highway merging and confident towing capability. The four-wheel drive system ensures dependable traction across varying road conditions, while the adaptive suspension automatically adjusts to road surfaces for a balanced ride whether you're commuting through city streets or navigating rougher terrain.

Inside, the thoughtfully appointed cabin prioritizes both passenger comfort and driver control. The heated and ventilated front seats adjust to your preferences, while the heated steering wheel adds comfort during colder months. Memory seat settings mean your preferred driving position is always one touch away. The three-row layout accommodates up to eight passengers with the third row split-bench seat power-folding for added cargo flexibility.

Technology features enhance both safety and convenience. The navigation system, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto compatibility keep you connected and informed. Lane Keep Assist, Automatic Emergency Braking, and Rear Cross Traffic Alert are designed to help you stay aware of your surroundings. The integrated trailer brake controller and hitch guidance system with hitch view make towing straightforward and manageable.

The AT4 trim level reflects GMC's commitment to serious capability. The Max Trailering Package includes the ProGrade Trailering System and extra capacity cooling system, supporting your most demanding towing needs. Hill Descent Control adds confidence during steep descents, while the multiple airbags and advanced braking systems provide comprehensive safety protection for every journey.

With OnStar Safety and Security services included for three years, GMC Connected Services, and comprehensive warranty support, you can drive with confidence knowing assistance is available when needed. This Yukon AT4 combines luxury appointments with genuine off-road composure, making it an excellent choice for buyers seeking a full-featured, capable family SUV.

The 2023 Ford Bronco Raptor continues to define what a factory-built desert-runner should be. Ford Performance engineers built the Raptor to go straight from the school run to genuine high-speed off-road work, and the results have made it one of the most respected extreme off-road SUVs money can buy. This particular example wears a Cactus Gray finish and comes to market backed by a clean CARFAX history report as a confirmed local trade-in. Finished with Advanced 4x4, this Bronco Raptor pairs genuine rock-crawling capability with the high-speed desert-running confidence that has made the Raptor name legendary. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Bronco nameplate earned the 2022 North American Utility Vehicle of the Year award by proving that a body-on-frame off-roader could be genuinely comfortable and capable at the same time, and the Raptor variant takes that formula to its logical extreme. Buyers cross-shopping the segment against the Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 392 consistently found that the Raptor's widened track, reinforced body structure, and Fox Live Valve suspension delivered a genuinely different level of high-speed off-road composure. Ford built the Raptor on a significantly reinforced version of the standard Bronco platform, with 50 percent greater body rigidity and a track more than six inches wider than even the Sasquatch-equipped Bronco, giving it the stability to handle high-speed desert running without sacrificing the tight, capable feel that makes rock crawling possible. That combination of genuine dual-purpose capability is why enthusiasts kept the Bronco Raptor at the very top of their off-road SUV shopping lists. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Automotive journalists consistently praised the Bronco Raptor for its legitimate rock-crawling credentials and its surprisingly composed, refined character for daily driving, a combination reviewers noted is rare even among dedicated off-road specialists. Critics highlighted the HOSS 4.0 suspension system's Fox Live Valve dampers as a standout feature, delivering genuine high-speed off-road composure without the harsh, floaty ride that similarly capable vehicles often exhibit. 2022 North American Utility Vehicle of the Year (Bronco nameplate) Widely praised by automotive journalists for its dual-purpose daily-driving refinement and genuine extreme off-road capability Warranty The odometer is hovering around the 13,489-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage 5-Year/60,000-Mile Powertrain Limited Warranty Covers the engine, transmission, and drivetrain components against manufacturing defects. Expiration: 06/09/2028 or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first. 5-Year/60,000-Mile Roadside Assistance Provides towing and emergency roadside support anywhere in the country. Expiration: 06/09/2028 or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first. 5-Year/Unlimited-Mile Corrosion Warranty Protects the body against rust-through corrosion. Expiration: 06/09/2028. Extended service plans may also be available to provide additional peace of mind throughout your ownership experience. Standard Features The Raptor sits at the top of the entire Bronco lineup, and there's only one way to order it: fully loaded. Every Raptor comes standard with the exclusive 3.0-liter EcoBoost V6, the HOSS 4.0 High-Performance Off-Road Stability Suspension with Fox Live Valve dampers, a 12-inch center touchscreen, a 360-degree camera system, and Ford's full Raptor Tool Kit, all wrapped in a cabin that feels genuinely purpose-built for serious off-road use. Standard 37-inch tires and a reinforced steering column give the Raptor genuine desert-runner credentials right out of the box, meaning there's no need to chase aftermarket upgrades to get the full Raptor experience. Installed Options This particular Bronco Raptor was ordered with several worthwhile additions beyond the standard Raptor equipment. Standalone Features 17-Inch Black Forged Beadlock-Capable Wheels Allow the tire bead to be mechanically secured to the wheel, reducing the risk of the tire dislodging during aggressive low-pressure off-road driving. Mechanical Features Power comes from Ford's exclusive 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged EcoBoost V6, rated at 418 horsepower and 440 lb-ft of torque and paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission with paddle shifters. The engine delivers genuinely strong, immediate acceleration, with enough low-end torque to make climbing steep grades or blasting across open desert feel effortless rather than strained. Equipped with Ford's Advanced 4x4 system and electronically locking front and rear differentials, this Bronco Raptor extends genuine rock-crawling capability well beyond what most off-road SUVs can manage, while the HOSS 4.0 suspension's Fox Live Valve dampers and independent front suspension with a Dana 44 axle soak up high-speed impacts that would rattle a lesser vehicle apart. Ford's G.O.A.T. Modes let the driver tailor the Raptor's throttle, transmission, and suspension behavior to match the terrain, whether crawling over rocks or running flat-out across open desert. Exterior Features The Bronco Raptor's widened fender flares, reinforced steel bumpers, and aggressive stance make its off-road intent obvious from every angle, a genuine departure from the standard Bronco's more restrained proportions. This example's Cactus Gray finish and gray molded-in-color hardtop suit that rugged character well, while the standard 37-inch all-terrain tires and available beadlock-capable wheels give it a commanding, purpose-built presence. Interior Features Inside, the Bronco Raptor pairs genuine off-road purposefulness with real everyday comfort, with supportive seating and durable materials designed to handle both daily commuting and serious trail use. Thoughtful details like the locking glove box and MOLLE strap system keep gear organized and secure, while the upgraded SiriusXM-capable audio system replaces the standard subwoofer-equipped setup for a different take on in-cabin sound. Infotainment & Technology Ford's 12-inch center touchscreen anchors this Bronco Raptor's technology suite, running SYNC 4 with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for effortless smartphone integration. FordPass Connect adds a built-in 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot, while the available SiriusXM-capable audio system and front and rear 360-degree camera system round out a genuinely well-equipped technology package. Safety Features This Bronco Raptor comes equipped with Ford's AdvanceTrac with RSC, front-row and side-impact safety canopy airbags across all rows, and a full suite of electronic stability aids designed to keep the vehicle composed in demanding conditions. The 360-degree camera system and Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking add further confidence, whether navigating tight trails or everyday traffic. ... and there's SO MUCH more! description: BOLD, POWERFUL, EXCLUSIVE, NO-ACCIDENT, ONE-OWNER, NONSMOKER, UNAPOLOGETIC PERFORMANCE AWAITS! The 2023 BMW XM marked a genuine turning point for BMW's M division -- the first standalone M model built from the ground up since the legendary M1, rather than a performance variant of an existing model. This XM doesn't borrow its identity from another BMW, it was conceived from day one as M's own flagship, and it shows in every detail. BMW refers to this body style as a Sports Activity Vehicle, or SAV -- the company's own term for a performance-oriented SUV that prioritizes driver engagement and road presence over outright off-road capability. In the XM's case, that philosophy is taken to its most extreme conclusion yet. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The XM occupies a category almost entirely of its own making: a plug-in hybrid V8 flagship built exclusively by BMW M, sharing its drivetrain concept with BMW's own Le Mans-winning M Hybrid V8 race car. Shoppers drawn to the XM aren't simply looking for a fast SUV -- they're looking for the kind of halo vehicle that only comes along once in a generation, one that pairs genuine electrified efficiency with a soundtrack and personality unlike anything else in BMW's lineup. Beyond its performance credentials, the XM has become known for a design language that refuses to blend in, along with an interior that leans further into bespoke luxury than any other M product before it. It's the kind of vehicle that buyers choose specifically because it doesn't look, sound, or drive like anything else on the road. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Reviewers have consistently singled out the XM's drivetrain as its defining strength, praising the effortless shove of its hybrid V8 and the genuinely engaging way it carries its considerable weight through corners. Its styling has proven divisive in the press, but nearly every review agrees on one point: the XM is impossible to ignore, and it delivers a driving experience that few three-row performance SUVs can match. WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 44,644-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage New Vehicle Limited Warranty Covers most non-wear components for bumper-to-bumper peace of mind. Expiration: 06/07/2027 or 50,000 miles, whichever comes first. High-Voltage Battery Warranty Protects the plug-in hybrid battery against defects. Expiration: 06/07/2031 or 80,000 miles, whichever comes first. Rust Perforation Warranty Covers rust-through of exterior body panels. Expiration: 06/07/2035. Extended service plans may also be available to provide additional peace of mind throughout your ownership experience. STANDARD FEATURES Every XM leaves the factory as a fully loaded flagship rather than a base model waiting for options -- there's no lower XM trim to step up from. Standard equipment already includes M xDrive all-wheel drive, adaptive M suspension, a fully digital cockpit, and the kind of bespoke interior detailing typically reserved for BMW's most exclusive individual-order vehicles. INSTALLED OPTIONS Standalone Features Full Merino Leather Upholstery (Deep Lagoon/Coffee) Wraps the cabin in one of BMW's most exclusive leather grades, offering a noticeably richer look and feel than standard hides. Bowers & Wilkins Diamond Surround Sound System Delivers concert-level clarity and depth throughout the cabin, one of the most respected audio systems available in any vehicle. M Sport Brakes with Blue Calipers Adds stronger stopping power and a more confident pedal feel to match the XM's substantial performance, along with a distinctive visual signature through the wheels. Nightgold Metallic Trim Adds a warm, distinctive metallic accent that sets this XM's cabin apart from the more common black or silver trim finishes. Finished in Carbon Black Metallic, this XM wears a purposeful, understated exterior that lets its aggressive proportions speak for themselves. CHARGING, RANGE & ELECTRIFIED POWERTRAIN This XM pairs its twin-turbocharged V8 with a 25.7-kWh battery and an integrated electric motor, giving it an EPA-estimated 30 miles of electric-only range for quiet, gasoline-free commuting before the V8 ever needs to wake up. Charging is handled through a Level 2 240-volt connection, which can fully replenish the battery in roughly 3 hours -- easily accomplished overnight or during a workday. The XM isn't equipped for public DC fast charging, since its plug-in hybrid system is designed primarily to top off at home rather than on the road. MECHANICAL FEATURES At the heart of this XM is a 4.4-liter twin-turbocharged V8 supported by an integrated electric motor, together producing a combined 644 horsepower and 590 lb-ft of torque -- enough to send this nearly three-ton SAV to 60 mph in the low four-second range. The 8-speed automatic transmission channels that power smoothly, while the electric motor fills in instantly off the line, masking any hint of turbo lag. Beyond straight-line speed, the XM's adaptive M suspension and M xDrive all-wheel-drive system work together to keep a vehicle of this size feeling remarkably composed through corners, while the electrified assist adds a layer of low-speed responsiveness that a traditional V8 alone couldn't match. It's a genuinely different kind of M car -- one built around effortless, electrified thrust rather than high-revving drama. EXTERIOR FEATURES The XM's design draws a hard line in the sand, with a towering front end, illuminated kidney grille, and sculpted rear haunches that make no attempt to blend in with the rest of BMW's lineup. This XM's Carbon Black Metallic finish lets those sharp, angular surfaces play with light and shadow rather than competing with a louder color. The M Sport brakes' blue calipers peek through the wheels as a subtle nod to the performance underneath, while the XM's massive proportions and low, wide stance give it a physical presence that photographs rarely capture fully. INTERIOR FEATURES Step inside and the XM feels less like a traditional SUV cabin and more like a bespoke lounge, with a floating center console, ambient lighting, and materials chosen to feel genuinely special rather than simply upgraded. This XM's Full Merino leather, finished in Deep Lagoon and Coffee, gives the cabin a striking two-tone presence that few other SUVs attempt. The Nightgold metallic trim adds a warm, jewelry-like accent throughout the cabin, while the Bowers & Wilkins Diamond Surround Sound System turns every drive into something closer to a private listening session than background noise. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY BMW's latest iDrive system anchors the cabin with a curved digital display spanning the driver's instrument cluster and central touchscreen, giving occupants an intuitive, fully digital command center for navigation, media, and vehicle settings. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep smartphones fully integrated without hunting for a cable. The Bowers & Wilkins Diamond Surround Sound System elevates the in-cabin experience further, while BMW's over-the-air update capability allows the vehicle to gain new features and refinements over time. BMW Connected Drive services provide remote vehicle access and monitoring. Subscription may be required. SAFETY FEATURES BMW's Driving Assistant suite comes standard, including forward collision warning with automatic emergency braking, blind-spot detection, and lane departure warning, all working quietly in the background to reduce driver workload despite the XM's performance-first mission. A surround-view camera system makes maneuvering the XM's substantial footprint noticeably easier in tight parking situations, while adaptive cruise control adds genuine confidence on longer highway stretches. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! This XM combines genuine ONE-OWNER, NO-ACCIDENT history with a rare combination of exclusive factory equipment, years of remaining factory coverage, and the kind of hybrid V8 performance that few SUVs on the planet can match. For a buyer who wants BMW M's most audacious statement yet, backed by real peace of mind, this is about as compelling an example as they come. Quiet on electrons, thunderous on demand. We will happily evaluate your TRADE-IN and offer EXCELLENT FINANCE OPTIONS as well, so please give us a call at 732-919-0707 (Wall Township) or 856-881-2869 (Sewell) TODAY!

This 2023 Chevrolet Suburban High Country in Black represents a premium full-size SUV built to deliver capability and refinement for families and professionals who demand both performance and comfort.

- Power panoramic dual-pane sunroof with express-open and power sunshade
- Adaptive cruise control
- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Premium Bose 10-speaker surround audio with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio
- 15-inch diagonal multi-color head-up display
- Heated and ventilated front seats with memory settings
- Power-adjustable outside heated mirrors with auto-dimming capability
- Magnetic ride control adaptive suspension with four-wheel independent design
- Enhanced automatic emergency braking and lane change alert with side blind zone alert
- Navigation system with rear camera and surround vision
- HD surround vision camera system
