The High Country trim elevates the ownership experience with premium leather seating surfaces, heated and ventilated front seats, and heated outboard rear seats for all-weather comfort. Power-folding third-row seats provide flexible cargo configurations, while the hands-free rear power liftgate adds genuine convenience for daily use. Inside, this Suburban addresses every convenience detail—remote start, illuminated entry, wireless charging, and a universal home remote transmitter are all standard.

The driving experience balances power and control through the adaptive Magnetic Ride Control suspension, which adjusts damping in real time for a smooth ride regardless of road conditions. Four-wheel independent suspension, speed-sensing steering, and electronic stability control work together to make this three-row SUV feel composed and planted. The 6.2L V8 delivers substantial capability when needed, while the 10-speed automatic transmission manages efficiency across varied driving situations.

Safety technology is comprehensive, including dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and occupant sensing systems. Enhanced automatic emergency braking, rear cross traffic alert, rear pedestrian alert, and the safety alert seat provide multiple layers of protection. Remote keyless entry, a trip computer, and outside temperature display provide practical information at a glance.

The three-row configuration with a split-folding rear seat and center armrest offers flexible interior arrangement. For entertainment, the New Rivian Elevation Audio system with 19 speakers creates comprehensive sound throughout the cabin, supported by steering-wheel-mounted controls and rear audio management.

This 2018 Jeep Grand Cherokee Trackhawk represents serious performance and capability, delivered with the refinement and features expected from a premium SUV. With its commanding presence and attention-grabbing black exterior, this vehicle demands respect on the road.

- 6.2L Supercharged HEMI V8 SRT engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD capability with adaptive and competition suspension systems
- 20" x 10" black satin aluminum wheels
- Suede/Nappa performance seats with heating and ventilation
- Uconnect 4C Navigation system with 8.4" display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- ParkView rear back-up camera

The Trackhawk stands at the pinnacle of Grand Cherokee performance, combining raw power with intelligent engineering. The supercharged engine provides substantial capability, while the four-wheel independent suspension and advanced traction systems ensure composed handling. The navigation system works seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected during every drive. Premium audio delivers clear, immersive sound through the 10-speaker setup.

Safety remains integrated throughout this vehicle's design. Dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags create a comprehensive safety net. Electronic stability control, traction control, and an anti-whiplash system work together to protect occupants. The anti-lock braking system with brake assist provides confident stopping power.

Practical features enhance daily usability. The power liftgate simplifies cargo access, while split folding rear seats maximize interior flexibility. Rain-sensing wipers, delay-off headlights, and a rear window defroster handle weather challenges automatically. The 2026 BMW X6 xDrive40i represents a refined choice for those seeking a premium athletic utility vehicle with genuine capability and sophisticated appointments.

- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Panoramic Moonroof
- Navigation system with Live Cockpit Pro
- Harman/Kardon Surround Sound System
- 4-Zone Automatic Climate Control with Front and Rear Heated Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel and Front Seat Armrests
- Premium leather interior
- Automatic Park Assistant with Parking View 3D Surround View
- Active Park Distance Control and Backup Assistant
- Trailer Assistant

This single-owner vehicle has been driven responsibly and comes to you as a non-smoker car with the remainder of BMW's factory warranty. The Gray exterior with its elegant Skyscraper Grey Metallic finish provides a contemporary aesthetic that complements the athletic proportions of this design.

The xDrive40i engine delivers balanced performance with its 3.0L DOHC 24-valve configuration paired to an 8-speed automatic sport transmission. This powertrain achieves 22 city MPG and 26 highway MPG, providing reasonable efficiency for a vehicle of this presence and capability. The all-wheel drive system ensures composed handling across varying road conditions.

Inside, the cabin reflects genuine luxury with leather appointments throughout, including the sport steering wheel and memory seat functionality. The climate control system offers granular comfort management with individual four-zone settings, heated and ventilated front seats, and a heated steering wheel. Premium audio through the Harman/Kardon system delivers refined sound reproduction for your journeys.

Technology integration is comprehensive, with seamless smartphone connectivity, navigation with real-time traffic, and BMW's ConnectedDrive Services. The parking assistance suite transforms challenging situations into straightforward maneuvers with automatic park assist, 3D surround view cameras, and trailer guidance. Remote engine start allows climate preconditioning before you enter the vehicle.

Go Lux Black Out Package styling elevates the visual presence with purposeful detailing. The 20-inch wheels and sport suspension tuning contribute to confident road manners while the panoramic moonroof expands the sense of interior space.

This BMW X6 xDrive40i represents substantial original value at an MSRP of $84,000 and is ready for a discerning driver who appreciates quality engineering and thoughtful design. We invite you to experience it firsthand.

The low tire pressure warning system and four-wheel disc ABS brakes provide added security on every journey.

Convenience technologies simplify daily operation. Rain-sensing wipers, auto high-beam headlights with delay-off functionality, and fully automatic operation minimize manual adjustments. Heated door mirrors and automatic headlights with delay-off functionality add convenience to everyday driving.

This GLE 350 represents an opportunity to own a well-equipped luxury SUV with minimal mileage. The cabin surrounds you with premium materials, including perforated leather seat trim, genuine wood console inserts, and a heated leather steering wheel that reflects the meticulous attention to detail Lexus is known for.

Safety stands as a priority with dual front airbags, side-impact airbags, anti-whiplash front head restraints, and the comprehensive Safety Connect emergency communication system. Active cruise control, traction control, and brake assist work together to help you navigate traffic with confidence. The four-wheel disc brake system provides reliable stopping power when you need it most.

Roadside Assistance is included for your peace of mind. Warranty deductible stands at $0. This vehicle includes comprehensive vehicle history documentation. As an L/Certified vehicle, you receive a comprehensive inspection with unlimited-mileage warranty coverage up to six years—combining the balance of the new car warranty (4 years/50,000 miles) with an additional 2 years of unlimited-mileage coverage. The 10-year/150,000-mile hybrid battery warranty provides extended protection on critical components. Your complimentary maintenance plan covers the first four basic factory-scheduled maintenance services for two years or 20,000 miles, helping you maintain this vehicle in optimal condition.

The practical benefits extend to everyday convenience. The power liftgate with kick sensor makes loading groceries effortless, while the split-folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs. Multiple storage solutions throughout the cabin keep your essentials organized and accessible. Heated front seats and automatic temperature control ensure comfort regardless of the season.

The combination of luxury amenities, advanced technology integration, comprehensive warranty coverage, and strong engineering makes this RX 350 Premium+ a sound investment. We invite you to schedule a time to visit our showroom, experience the refined comfort this vehicle offers, and begin your ownership journey with confidence.

We invite you to experience this remarkable blend of design, comfort, and capability. Schedule your visit to the showroom today.

This 2024 Chevrolet Tahoe Z71 in Black represents a premium three-row SUV designed for those who need commanding capability with refined comfort on both highway and off-road terrain.

- Advanced Trailering Package with Integrated Trailer Brake Controller and Smart Trailer Integration
- Z71 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and 2-Speed Active Electronic AutoTrac Transfer Case
- Off-Road Capability Package for enhanced trail performance
- Magnetic Ride Control Suspension with Air Ride Adaptive Suspension for responsive handling
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Navigation and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto compatibility
- Bose 9-Speaker Audio System with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio
- Heated and cooled leather-appointed front seats with 10-way power adjustment and memory settings
- 20-inch machined aluminum wheels complementing the aggressive Z71 stance
- Hands-Free Power Programmable Liftgate with HD Surround Vision for convenient loading
- Heated steering wheel and premium power telescopic steering column
- Electronic Limited-Slip Differential and Electronic Stability Control for confident traction
- Luxury Package features including auto-dimming inside rear-view mirror and universal home remote

- Red horizontal-mounted recovery hooks and black tubular assist steps for rugged capability

The Tahoe Z71 combines practical truck heritage with contemporary convenience. The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission delivers consistent power while returning 15 MPG city and 20 MPG highway. Four-wheel drive with the 2-Speed Active Electronic AutoTrac Transfer Case handles varied driving conditions, whether navigating city streets or venturing off pavement.

Seating spans three comfortable rows with leather upholstery throughout the front. Driver and front passenger seats feature independent 10-way power adjustment and heating functions. The second row offers heated outboard positions with a 60/40 split-folding design, while the third row provides a 60/40 power-folding bench that maximizes cargo flexibility when not carrying passengers.

Technology integration supports modern lifestyles through the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with built-in navigation. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keep your smartphone interface accessible, while wireless charging accommodates compatible devices. SiriusXM 360L satellite radio provides entertainment options across the country, and the Bose audio system delivers quality sound throughout the cabin.

Safety features include multiple airbag deployment zones, electronic stability control, traction control, and advanced awareness systems. Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, and Rear Pedestrian Alert provide situational awareness during maneuvering. The HD Surround Vision system with Hitch View image adjustment assists with parking and trailer hookup operations.

This Z71 stands ready to handle your next adventure with genuine capability and comfortable appointments for the entire family.

The 2024 Navigator L Black Label represents luxury SUV ownership at its finest, combining thoughtful design, responsive performance, and comprehensive technology to elevate every drive. - Power Tilt/Slide Panoramic Roof with Power Sunshade
- TRD Pro Package
- V6 Hybrid with 10-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- Pro High Grade Full LED Headlamps with TRD Pro LED Light Bar
- JBL 14-Speaker Premium Audio System
- TRD Pro Leather-Trimmed Steering Wheel
- Wireless Smartphone Charger
- Navigation System with Drive Connect including Cloud Navigation and Google POI
- Multi-Terrain Rear Back Monitor
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats with TRD Pro SofTex Trim
- 20-Inch Machined-Finish Alloy Wheels
- Tow Technology Package
- Cast Aluminum Step and Step Cover
- Auto-Dimming Rear-View Mirror
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Compatibility

The V6 Hybrid powertrain paired with 10-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD provides the capability you need while delivering an estimated 19 mpg city and 22 mpg highway. This combination ensures you can tackle demanding terrain without sacrificing efficiency at the pump.

Inside, the cabin reflects the TRD Pro's commitment to quality and comfort. Heated and ventilated front seats with TRD Pro SofTex trim accommodate your passengers in style, while the JBL 14-speaker audio system delivers exceptional sound quality. The panoramic roof with power sunshade floods the interior with natural light, and the wireless smartphone charger keeps your devices powered throughout your journey.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily drive with the Navigation System featuring Drive Connect, including Cloud Navigation with real-time traffic and Google POI access. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility ensures your smartphone connects effortlessly, while the multi-terrain rear back monitor provides visibility in challenging driving situations. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror adapts to headlight glare for enhanced safety.

The TRD Pro Package and Tow Technology Package equip this Sequoia with specialized features including the cast aluminum step and step cover for convenient entry, and the TRD Pro under cover and protector for added durability. The pro high-grade full LED headlamps and TRD Pro LED light bar deliver superior illumination and distinctive styling.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, speed-sensing steering, and brake assist work together to maintain control in various driving conditions. The Safety Connect emergency communication system provides peace of mind with a 10-year trial.

description:
The 2024 Land Rover Defender 110 X combines refined capability with premium comfort, delivering a vehicle that performs as well as it looks in striking black.

- Connected Navigation PIVI Pro system
- 400W 11-speaker Meridian sound system with SiriusXM
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Power sunroof
- 14-way climate-controlled electric memory front seats with heating and ventilation
- Heated steering wheel
- Heated rear seats
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- Genuine wood console and door panel inserts
- 20-inch gloss dark grey alloy wheels
- Adaptive suspension with four-wheel independent design
- Auto high-beam headlights with fog lights
- Rear parking camera
- Dual front zone automatic climate control

This Defender 110 X seats five passengers in Windsor leather trim with heated front and rear seating that adapts to your preferences. The power-adjustable front seats feature memory settings, and the rear seats fold to accommodate cargo when needed. Climate comfort extends to the heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic temperature control, ensuring every occupant travels in comfort.

The three-liter turbocharged inline-six engine and eight-speed automatic transmission deliver balanced power and efficiency, achieving 17 mpg city and 20 mpg highway. All-wheel drive with adaptive suspension provides confident handling on any road condition, supported by speed-sensing steering that adjusts responsiveness to your driving speed and four-wheel independent suspension for refined ride quality.

Your journey stays connected through the integrated navigation system, 11-speaker sound system, and smartphone integration via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The heads-up display keeps essential information visible without diverting your attention from the road. Multiple convenience features—including HomeLink garage door transmitter, auto-dimming mirrors, memory seats, and illuminated entry—reflect the thoughtful engineering throughout.

Safety systems include dual front and side airbags, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, traction control, electronic stability control, and a rear parking camera to aid visibility when backing. The comprehensive airbag design and multiple impact protection systems provide confidence during every drive.

This 2024 Ford Expedition Max Platinum represents a commanding presence on the road, engineered to deliver capability and refinement for those who demand both.

- Ford BlueCruise 1.0 with 3-year subscription
- Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow Package with Pro Trailer Backup Assist
- 360-Degree Camera with Trailer Reverse Guidance
- Integrated Trailer Brake Controller and Front Tow Hooks
- ControlTrac with 3.73 Axle Ratio and electronic limited-slip differential
- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 22 speakers
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and Connected Navigation
- Heated and ventilated premium leather front captain's chairs
- Power moonroof and power liftgate
- Heated steering wheel with memory positioning
- Adaptive independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off functionality

Equipped with a 3.5L EcoBoost V6 twin-turbocharged engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability, this Expedition Max balances performance with efficiency, achieving 16 mpg city and 22 mpg highway. The Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow Package combines practical towing features—including the 3.73 axle ratio, integrated trailer brake controller, and Pro Trailer Backup Assist—making this vehicle ready for serious hauling responsibilities.

The interior reflects Platinum-level refinement with heated and ventilated premium leather front captain's chairs, a heated steering wheel with memory settings, and genuine wood accents throughout the dashboard, console, and door panels. The B&O Unleashed Sound System delivers premium audio through 22 speakers, while SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition and connected navigation keeps you informed and in control.

Technology integration extends to comprehensive camera systems, including a 360-degree camera with trailer reverse guidance that simplifies maneuvering in tight spaces. Ford BlueCruise 1.0, included with a 3-year subscription, adds convenience to highway driving when conditions permit.

Safety and comfort merge seamlessly with dual front zone automatic temperature control, rear air conditioning, three-row seating with split-folding capability, and a comprehensive airbag system. The adaptive independent suspension combined with speed-sensing steering enhances both handling and ride quality across varying road conditions.

With 10,220 miles on the odometer, this Black Expedition Max remains virtually new, offering the assurance of minimal use while providing access to a vehicle fully equipped and ready for your lifestyle. The 22-inch polished aluminum wheels and body-color bumpers complete an exterior presentation worthy of its Platinum designation.

We invite you to experience this Expedition Max firsthand and discover how its combination of capability, luxury, and technology can serve your family's needs.

This 2024 Toyota Land Cruiser First Edition delivers refined capability wrapped in striking yellow exterior paint that commands attention wherever you travel.

- 2.4L 4-Cylinder Engine with 8-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- Heated & Ventilated Front Seats with Leather Trim
- Power Moonroof
- Drive Connect Cloud Navigation with 1-Year Trial Subscription
- Heads-Up Display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- 14-Speaker Audio System with SiriusXM
- Auto High-Beam Headlights with Fog Lights
- Heated Steering Wheel with Memory Function
- Power Liftgate
- 18" Alloy Wheels
- Memory Driver Seat with Power Adjustment
- Exterior Parking Camera
- Safety Connect Emergency Communication System
- Dual Zone Automatic Climate Control

The powertrain combines a 2.4L 4-cylinder engine with an 8-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive, delivering 22 city miles per gallon and 25 highway miles per gallon. This configuration provides efficient performance suitable for both daily commuting and off-road exploration, balancing capability with fuel economy.

The interior showcases premium appointments including leather seat trim, heated and ventilated front seats, and a heated steering wheel. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while dual-zone automatic climate control ensures comfort for all occupants. Power adjustment for the driver seat combined with memory settings personalizes your driving position for every trip.

Technology integration is seamless with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, a 14-speaker audio system featuring SiriusXM satellite radio, and the Drive Connect Cloud Navigation system with a one-year trial subscription included. The heads-up display projects essential information onto the windshield, minimizing distractions while driving. HomeLink garage door transmitter functionality adds everyday convenience.

Safety systems are comprehensive, featuring dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags throughout the cabin. Electronic stability control, traction control, and ABS brakes work together to enhance vehicle control. The exterior parking camera assists during reversals, while the Safety Connect emergency communication system provides up to ten years of trial coverage.

Practical features round out this First Edition's appeal, including the power liftgate for easy cargo access, rain-sensing wipers for adaptive operation, and decorative roof rack and spoiler. Remote keyless entry and automatic temperature control streamline daily operation.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this 2024 Land Cruiser First Edition and discover why it represents an excellent choice for those seeking premium capability and technology in one distinctive package.

Heated and ventilated front seats create the perfect climate for every season, while heated second-row outboard seats extend that luxury to your passengers. The power-folding third-row bench seat maximizes flexibility for cargo and passengers alike. A heated steering wheel, automatic temperature control with rear air conditioning, and the panoramic sunroof make every journey pleasant regardless of weather or season.

The 15-inch head-up display keeps critical information in your line of sight while maintaining focus on the road.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily routine. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with navigation puts directions at your fingertips, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keep your smartphone's features accessible. Wireless charging eliminates the need for cables, and OnStar services with Chevrolet connected services provide assistance whenever needed. Remote start, hands-free rear power liftgate, and universal home remote control add convenience to every stop.

Trailering capabilities are enhanced with dedicated systems. The auxiliary trailer camera with enhanced trailer view, trailering assist guidelines, and integrated trailer brake controller make towing straightforward and safe. Trailer tire pressure monitor sensors keep you informed of your trailer's condition, and the smart trailer integration indicator monitors the health of your towing setup.

This Suburban Premier represents a commanding presence on the road backed by genuine capability and thoughtful design. Visit our showroom to explore the full scope of what this vehicle offers your family.

The 2024 BMW X7 M60i delivers commanding presence and sophisticated capability for those who demand both performance and versatility. This luxury SUV combines refined engineering with the practicality needed for modern family life.

- 4.4L V8 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and AWD
- Driving Assistance Professional Package with Highway Assistant and Active Driving Assistant Pro
- Climate Comfort Package with 5-zone climate control and front and rear heated seats
- Front ventilated seats for enhanced comfort
- 22-inch double-spoke alloy wheels
- Panoramic moonroof
- BMW Maps Navigation system
- Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go
- Traffic Jam Assistant
- Active Lane Keeping Assistant
- Harman/Kardon surround sound system with 16 speakers
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Trailer hitch for towing capability
- Second row captain's chairs for individual seating

The cabin reflects BMW's commitment to luxury through the use of genuine wood trim on the dashboard, door panels, and console insert. Extended Merino leather upholstery wraps the heated, power-adjustable front seats, while the heated steering wheel adds warmth on cooler mornings. The second row captain's chairs provide individual comfort and easy access to the third row, which features a split-folding bench design with a reclining function.

Technology integration elevates every drive through the Live Cockpit Pro display and gesture control functionality. The Heads-Up Display projects essential information directly into your line of sight, while the Connected Package Pro enables seamless smartphone integration through both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. SiriusXM satellite radio with a one-year Platinum Plan subscription keeps entertainment options available throughout your travels.

Driver assistance systems work together to enhance confidence and safety. The Highway Assistant allows hands-off driving up to 85 mph on limited access highways, while the Traffic Jam Assistant manages stop-and-go conditions. Active Lane Keeping Assistant and side collision avoidance round out the comprehensive protection suite, with BMW Assist eCall providing emergency communication support when needed.

The X7 M60i achieves 16 mpg in city driving and 21 mpg on the highway, providing reasonable efficiency for a vehicle of its size and capability. This 2024 Chevrolet Tahoe Z71 in Black delivers the capability and comfort you need for any journey, whether navigating city streets or tackling off-road terrain.

- Power panoramic dual-pane sunroof with express-open/close and power sunshade
- Luxury Package with premium comfort features and advanced technology
- Bose 9-speaker stereo audio system with Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium
- Heated steering wheel and heated front and second-row outboard seats
- Second-row power bucket seats with power release and third-row power split-folding bench seats
- HD Surround Vision for enhanced awareness around the vehicle
- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Rear Pedestrian Alert and Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert
- Hill Descent Control and 2-Speed Active Electronic AutoTrac Transfer Case
- Power tilt and telescopic steering column with memory settings
- SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio
- Hands-free rear power programmable liftgate
- Auto high-beam headlights with rain-sensing wipers
- Wireless charging for mobile devices
- Leather-appointed seat trim with power adjustable seating throughout

The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission provides responsive performance, delivering 15 city MPG and 20 highway MPG. The 4WD system features a 2-Speed Active Electronic AutoTrac Transfer Case with Hill Descent Control, giving you confidence on challenging terrain. Black tubular assist steps and a front high-approach angle fascia enhance both functionality and appearance.

Inside, the Luxury Package elevates your experience with driver alert technology, memory settings for the driver seat and mirrors, and outside heated power-adjustable mirrors with integrated turn signal indicators. The panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the climate control system manages comfort for all three rows with rear air conditioning.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily driving. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system connects with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you informed and entertained. Multiple airbags, electronic stability control, and a comprehensive suite of safety features work together to protect your family.

The seating arrangement accommodates up to nine passengers with flexible configurations. Front high-back reclining bucket seats provide excellent support, while power-folding second and third-row seats maximize cargo space when needed. Memory settings for the driver ensure your preferred position loads automatically every time you enter the vehicle.

A comprehensive warranty and reliable Chevrolet engineering support your investment in this capable full-size SUV. Visit our showroom today to experience the 2024 Tahoe Z71 and discover how its blend of luxury, technology, and performance aligns with your lifestyle.

Premium smooth-ride suspension absorbs road imperfections while maintaining stability. The independent four-wheel suspension geometry supports both responsive handling and ride quality.

Safety integration includes multiple airbags positioned strategically throughout the cabin, electronic stability control, and advanced driver-assistance features that work together to support your confidence behind the wheel. The rear cross-traffic alert, rear pedestrian alert, and surround vision system enhance your awareness of the surrounding environment.

With this 2024 Tahoe Z71, you're investing in a vehicle engineered for those who demand both performance and premium refinement. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this full-size SUV firsthand and discuss how it meets your transportation needs.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

The combination of engineering and performance means you have the muscle to handle both highway driving and challenging conditions with confidence.

The High Country trim elevates the experience with premium leather appointments, advanced comfort technology, and refined styling details. Memory settings for driver preferences, a wrapped steering wheel, and chrome door handles with body-color accents demonstrate attention to quality. The power tilt and telescopic steering column adjusts to your ideal driving position, and wireless charging keeps your devices ready.

For families and those who tow, this Tahoe excels. The Max Trailering Package includes extra capacity cooling, trailer tire pressure monitor sensors, and an integrated trailer brake controller. Enhanced Trailer View provides multiple camera perspectives, while the Hitch View offers pan and zoom capability for precision backing. Hill Descent Control assists on steep grades, and the 2-speed Active Electronic AutoTrac transfer case provides versatility.

Safety and awareness technology create confidence in your surroundings. Enhanced automatic emergency braking, rear pedestrian alert, trailer side blind zone alert, and rear cross traffic alert work together to monitor potential hazards. The safety alert seat provides tactile feedback when risks are detected. Dual front and side-impact airbags, plus overhead airbags, complement these active systems.

Inside, the cabin combines luxury with practicality. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system integrates seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay or Android Auto. Climate control manages temperature in front and rear zones independently, while heated rear outboard seats extend comfort to all passengers. The Enhanced Driver Information Center keeps essential data at your fingertips.

With one owner on the Carfax report and approximately 35,961 miles, this Tahoe High Country offers the reliability of a carefully maintained, well-established vehicle. The combination of premium features, trailering capability, and genuine leather luxury makes this a compelling choice for those seeking a full-size SUV that delivers on all fronts.
